title: Wild AG ticker
description: An endless horizontal ticker: its content is laid twice side by side and the pair slides left by one copy, linear and forever, so the line never ends. Used for a giant type line and for a row of partner tiles.
notes: CSS only; reduced motion stops it in place
the content should be at least as wide as the window, or repeat it inside before passing it
name: wild-ag-ticker

props.name: children
props.description: one copy of the line; it is repeated once to close the loop

props.name: duration
props.description: seconds for one copy to pass

props.name: gap
props.description: space between the items and between the two copies, as a CSS length
